title: chiliadenus rupestris
intro: Chiliadenus rupestris, commonly known as Rock Rose or Mountain Rose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Chiliadenus rupestris include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
